# Mic Drop

> Open mic sign-ups, minus the chaos.

Mic Drop is a lightweight web app for managing open mic night sign-ups. Hosts create a mic event with a name, date, and slot count; comedians sign up via a shared link — no accounts, no apps, no spreadsheets.

## Core Features

- **Create a mic** — Hosts set a name, date, and number of performer slots
- **Shareable links** — Each mic gets a unique slug-based URL (e.g. `/tuesday-night-laughs`)
- **No-account sign-ups** — Comedians add their name to the list directly from the link
- **Email reminders** — Automated reminder emails sent to sign-ups before the show
- **Admin dashboard** — Hosts can view and manage all their mics at `/admin`

## Project Structure

- `app/page.tsx` — Homepage / landing page
- `app/create/page.tsx` — Create a new open mic event
- `app/[slug]/page.tsx` — Public sign-up page for a specific mic
- `app/admin/page.tsx` — Admin dashboard (authenticated)
- `app/admin/[slug]/page.tsx` — Admin detail view for a specific mic
- `app/api/send-reminders/` — API route for day-of reminder emails
- `app/api/send-week-reminders/` — API route for week-ahead reminder emails
- `app/actions.ts` — Server actions for sign-up logic
- `app/admin/actions.ts` — Server actions for admin operations
- `middleware.ts` — Auth middleware protecting `/admin` routes
